_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 36 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves, this is a confirmed coil where HOLD is the statistically dominant call and any directional bet requires a named breaker that neither brain has credibly identified.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction based on coil base rates; narrative leans toward reversal optimism without a directional call, creating a tension between data-driven patience and pattern-driven anticipation
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 20 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 60 with funding dropping below 40
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 85 OR etf_flows collapse below 70 with exchange_netflow turning negative (inflows)
